title: GTA 6 Is Already Out in New Zealand: The Catch
short_title: GTA 6 is already OUT in New Zealand (the catch) #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description: GTA 6 unlocked in New Zealand at 6 AM ET, and players are using the region trick to play 18 hours early. The catch: store rules, a reported Twitch warning to a streamer, and fake gift card scams. Sources: Newsweek, Gamereactor, VICE, Notebookcheck. #ViceReplayBreaking

short.headline: Already out in NZ
short.text: GTA 6 is already out in New Zealand. And some players far from there are playing it right now, eighteen hours early. But there's a catch.
short.text_es: GTA 6 ya salió en Nueva Zelanda. Y hay jugadores muy lejos de allí jugándolo ahora mismo, dieciocho horas antes. Pero hay una trampa.

short.headline: The region trick
short.text: They switch their console's region and time zone to New Zealand. On Xbox, it's the location setting. And you may have to buy it from the New Zealand store.
short.text_es: Cambian la región y la zona horaria de la consola a Nueva Zelanda. En Xbox es la ubicación. Y puede que tengas que comprarlo en la tienda de Nueva Zelanda.

short.headline: Streamers warned
short.text: It's risky. A German streamer says a Twitch partner manager warned him he could be suspended for streaming it early.
short.text_es: Es arriesgado. Un streamer alemán dice que un encargado de Twitch le advirtió que podían suspenderlo por transmitirlo antes.

short.headline: Scam alert
short.text: And watch out for fake cheap gift card deals. So, are eighteen hours worth the risk? Tell me below, because
short.text_es: Y cuidado con las tarjetas de regalo baratas falsas. ¿Valen la pena dieciocho horas? Dímelo abajo, porque
